attempts.summary: Configured a persistent SSH tunnel from node2 127.0.0.1:9082 to node1 127.0.0.1:9081. Both listeners remain loopback-only, the supplied application and document are unchanged, automatic SSH reconnection was demonstrated, and both nodes recovered successfully from separate restarts with changed boot identities. Ubuntu 24.04 and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic were retained.
